rules.name: OOC insults
rules.text: OOC insults are prohibited. This includes, but is not limited to, insulting, harassing, or mocking another player, including mocking a player's accent. If the behaviour is determined to be targeting a person's culture, nationality, or ethnicity, the case may be escalated to Management for review and may result in a ban based on the severity of the incident.
rules.punishment: Mute 180 minutes or Ban up to 7 days (based on severity)
rules.note: Targeting culture, nationality or ethnicity can be escalated to Management and may end in a ban by severity.

rules.name: N word / F word
rules.text: The N word and F word are strictly prohibited and may not be used in game, on the forums or within the discord.
rules.note: Applies in game, on the forums and in the Discord.

rules.name: English only in IC
rules.text: All players must be able to speak clear English all IC interactions must take place in English only. (other languages are permitted in private conversations only if all parties involved have expressed agreement).
rules.exception: other languages are permitted in private conversations only if all parties involved have expressed agreement

rules.name: Prime chat is OOC
rules.text: Prime chat is OOC, and should be treated as such. No information in prime chat may be used ICLY

rules.name: Ear raping (loud / disruptive audio)
rules.text: Ear Raping Intentionally using extremely loud or disruptive audio to annoy, disrupt, or interfere with other players

rules.name: Cheats / advantage software
rules.section: Cheating and Use of Illegal Software & Script Exploitation
rules.text: Any software which gives you advantage, cheats etc. are strictly prohibited! (Moonwalking, Aimbotting, Speed Boosting Filters which Remove particles of any kind)

rules.name: Bug abuse (incl. shooting through vents)
rules.section: Cheating and Use of Illegal Software & Script Exploitation
rules.text: Intentionally exploiting any bugs that give you any advantage is strictly prohibited Including shooting through vents
rules.punishment: warn (report all bugs that can be exploited when you find them!)

rules.name: Script exploitation (gains removed)
rules.section: Cheating and Use of Illegal Software & Script Exploitation
rules.text: Exploiting server scripts, bugs, or glitches is prohibited. Any gains from exploits will be removed, including money or inventory wipes, with further punishment based on severity
rules.punishment: Gains removed (money or inventory wipes), further punishment based on severity

rules.name: Report misuse
rules.section: Rules on Interactions with the Administration
rules.text: The use of report should only be used for questions related to the game or if you see or are involved in a current rule break.

rules.name: Insulting the administration
rules.section: Rules on Interactions with the Administration

rules.name: /me /do /try /to-do misuse

rules.name: Leaving an RP situation (combat log)
rules.text: It is forbidden to leave the RP situation before it finishes. (ex: not accepting first aid, leaving the game, going afk or entering into interiors).

rules.name: Emptying org warehouses / money
rules.text: It is forbidden to empty org warehouses & Money for personal purposes. Including, legal orgs, gangs
rules.punishment: Ban up to 30 days + Account Wipe

rules.name: Crimes against EMS

rules.text:
NLR If you are killed fully you may not return to the same area for at least 20 minutes.
(Note - if you are killed in a event of any kind you may NOT return to that event even if 20 minutes has passed)

rules.name: Mercy killing / finishing downed players mid-incident
rules.short: Mercy killing / finishing downed players mid-incident
rules.text: Mercy killing a player to help them avoid roleplay situations is prohibited. Additionally, players may not finish (execute) a downed player during an active incident. A player may only be finished once all active hostilities have ceased and the roleplay situation has concluded.
rules.exception: This restriction does not apply within the Ghetto. Players may execute downed players within Ghetto boundaries at any time, except during official IC events taking place within the Ghetto, where executions remain prohibited until all active hostilities have ceased and the roleplay situation has concluded.

killed me while i was down

context.ghetto: Ghetto exception: executing downed players is allowed at any time inside the Ghetto, except during official IC events there (then only after hostilities end and the RP concludes).
context.event: During official IC events in the Ghetto, executions stay prohibited until hostilities end and the RP concludes.

rules.name: Robbing a car (1 car + 2 people, demand stop, 4 tyres)
rules.text: While attempting to pull another car over for robbing you must have a minimum of 1 car with 2 people and you must shoot out the tires to demand them to stop, you must demand them to stop before shooting out their four tires (if they don't stop it is considered FailRP)
rules.note: The robbed driver who does not stop after the demand and 4 tyres is FailRP (GR 6.6).

rules.name: Car robbery: who may shoot back
rules.short: Car robbery: who may shoot back
rules.text: Adding on to 5.13, if you have 1 car and 2 people the driver of the other car CAN get out and shoot back, HOWEVER, if you have 2 cars and 4 people then the other driver CAN NOT get out and shoot back they must get out of car and raise hands. Exception, if the car being robbed has 2 or more people they are allowed to get out and shoot back, no matter the number robbing
rules.exception: if the car being robbed has 2 or more people they are allowed to get out and shoot back, no matter the number robbing
rules.note: 1 car / 2 robbers → the lone driver may shoot back. 2 cars / 4 robbers → the lone driver must get out with hands up (else FearRP, GR 6.8). Robbed car with 2+ people → may shoot back regardless.

rules.name: Anti-AFK
rules.text: Anti AFK is the act in which you prevent your player from falling asleep using any means, macros, holding down buttons with a weight etc and is Strictly Forbidden

rules.name: Mixing (OOC knowledge in RP)
rules.text: Mixing is Using information your character wouldn't realistically know is not allowed. Keep all OOC knowledge out of roleplay, this includes information related to or directing to forums. Ex: “easy gov, a god is watching,” etc

rules.name: Power Gaming (PG)
rules.text:
Power Gaming (PG) is the act of performing unrealistic actions, abusing game mechanics, or forcing actions that provide an unfair advantage or negatively impact roleplay.
Example: Using unrealistic /me commands (e.g., /me tackles ___ and stabs them to death) to force an outcome on another player.
rules.exception: Actions that are supported by the game script and do not materially affect the roleplay outcome are not considered Power Gaming solely because a weapon is in the player's hand. This includes actions such as patching, robbing, cuffing, dragging, or other scripted interactions while holding a weapon. These actions may still be addressed under other server rules if they are otherwise abused or used unrealistically

rules.name: Rule Exception (adjusting punishments)
rules.text: All punishments, regardless of the rule category, are subject to adjustment at the discretion of the administrative team based on the circumstances of the violation, including the severity of the offense and any prior or repeated violations. Any reduction to an issued punishment may only be authorized by the administrator who originally issued the punishment or by a member of Management.
rules.note: Any admin may adjust by circumstances, severity and history. Only the admin who issued it, or Management, may REDUCE an issued punishment.

rules.name: Account sharing / selling
rules.text: The account you create is your sole property, it may not be shared, sold or traded.

rules.name: Owner responsible for the account (hacked)

rules.note: The owner carries sole responsibility for the account, including when it is hacked.

rules.name: Fraud against players
rules.text: Committing any acts of fraud against other players is strictly prohibited.
rules.note: The rule text does not separate IC scam roleplay from OOC fraud; where the line sits is staff discretion (AR intro).

rules.name: Max 2 characters per account
rules.text: You may only have 2 total characters bound to your account. Alts are allowed primarily for exploring different roleplay styles, characters, or factions without metagaming or economy abuse.
rules.punishment: Deletion of any others and a Wipe to the 1st and 2nd

rules.name: One business per person
rules.text: All Players are only allowed 1 business across both characters 1 person - 1 business.
rules.punishment: Ban 20 days for each account and loss of business

rules.name: Transfer limits (7M per transaction / 2M per day)
rules.text: It is prohibited to transfer or gift any property, clothing, or items with a value exceeding 7,000,000 in a single transaction; you may only transfer or receive a maximum of 2,000,000 per day — withdrawals and deposits to/from Clan balances are exempt. Players are strictly forbidden from bypassing the 2,000,000 daily limit by creating new Clans just to transfer money, using alternate/twink accounts, routing funds through multiple players or accounts, or using any other method intended to exceed this cap.
rules.exception: withdrawals and deposits to/from Clan balances are exempt.
rules.note: Two separate limits: one transaction may not exceed 7,000,000 in value; and no more than 2,000,000 may be sent or received per day. Clan balance deposits/withdrawals do not count, but creating a clan just to move money does.

rules.name: Main and second character may not interact
rules.short: Main and second character may not interact
rules.text: Any interaction between your main and second character is prohibited. (ex: transferring money or property by any means), See 1.11 Rule

rules.name: Realistic names, no celebrities
rules.text: Names of characters must be realistic, celebrity names are prohibited.

rules.name: Real money trading (RMT)
rules.text: Real money trading (RMT) Is strictly forbidden. You may not buy, sell trade or offer any in-game assets (money, items, vehicles, properties, businesses, characters, etc.) for real world currency, gifts, services or any form of external gratuity

rules.name: Impersonating staff
rules.text: Impersonating staff is prohibited.

rules.name: No main ↔ alt interaction at all (linked accounts)
rules.short: No main ↔ alt interaction at all
rules.text:
No interactions whatsoever between your main and alt accounts. This includes:
         Money/item/vehicle/property transfers
         Information sharing (OOC/IC)
         Joint roleplay, gang/family membership, coordinated actions, or any form of assistance
         Using one to benefit the other (eg., scouting, backup, economy manipulation, or faction overlap)
Alts cannot be used to evade bans, restrictions, or server systems on the main.
If any connection or interaction is discovered (via logs, reports, or investigation), both accounts are treated as linked. (if you are banned on you primary account your secondary account will share the length of that ban)
rules.note: No separate punishment is listed. Once linked, both accounts share the ban length of the primary. For transfers between them, AR 1.7 sets Ban 20 days and Account Wipe.

rules.text: Dead participants must follow all event-specific death rules and may not re-enter the event unless authorized by staff.
rules.punishment: Event Disqualification / Official Clan/Cartel Warning / Refinement 60 Minutes

rules.name: No griefing / trolling events
rules.text: Intentional griefing, trolling, or disrupting an event for participating Clans/Cartels is prohibited.
rules.punishment: Event Disqualification / Official Clan/Cartel Warning / Refinement 60 Minutes

rules.name: No leaving the event area to reach inaccessible spots
rules.short: No leaving the event area to reach inaccessible spots
rules.text: Participants may not leave the designated event area in order to access a location, position, rooftop, building, or other area that cannot be accessed from within the designated event zone. Leaving the event area to gain access to an otherwise inaccessible position or to gain an unfair advantage is prohibited.
rules.punishment: Event Disqualification / Official Clan/Cartel Warning / Refinement 60 Minutes

rules.name: POV for any OOC event on request
rules.short: POV for any OOC event on request
rules.text: All participants in any OOC event must be able to provide their POV to server staff upon request. POV may be requested for investigations, rule violations, disputes, reports, appeals, or any other situation requiring staff review of the event.
rules.punishment: Event Disqualification / Official Clan/Cartel Warning / Refinement 60 Minutes

rules.name: Illegal activity: approved clothing AND approved vehicles
rules.short: Illegal activity: approved clothing AND approved vehicles
rules.text: During any illegal Clan/Cartel activity, all participating members must wear their required approved Clan/Cartel clothing at all times and must use approved Clan/Cartel vehicles.

rules.name: Cartel Row neutral zone; trespassers on cartel property
rules.short: Cartel Row neutral zone; trespassers on cartel property
rules.text: Cartel Row is a Neutral Zone, with the exception of each Cartel’s designated property. Anyone who enters another Cartel’s property without permission may be immediately engaged without additional RP. Once they leave the property, the engagement must cease and they may not be pursued under this rule.
rules.note: Not RDM: a trespasser on another cartel's property may be engaged without RP. Once they leave the property it must stop; pursuing them is the violation.

rules.name: Captured trespassers may be taken hostage
rules.short: Captured trespassers may be taken hostage
rules.text: Anyone caught on another Cartel’s property may be taken hostage and used for illegal activity or negotiations with another Cartel or Police. Once captured, all normal hostage and RP rules apply.

rules.name: Gov / Judges / Attorneys / EMS: no corruption
rules.short: Gov / Judges / Attorneys / EMS: no corruption
rules.text: Governor/Governess,Judges,Attorneys,and EMS employees must comply with state legislation and must not engage in corruption.

rules.name: Corruption only with an approved Corruption Bio (max 2 per org)
rules.short: Corruption only with an approved Corruption Bio
rules.text: Employees of a State Organization may only participate in corruption if they have an approved Corruption Bio. Each organization may have a maximum of 2 approved Corruption Bios, and the organization leader may participate in corruption without a bio. If a leader is caught engaging in corruption, it must be proven ICLY through the court system, and they may be removed from their position by the Government. All Corruption Bios must be approved by the organization leader and the Chief of State.
rules.exception: (Any corruption that is proven through the court system, and punished ICLY, shall not also have a OOC punishment implemented. This includes leaders, or any other employees that are proven to partake in corruption through the court system)
rules.note: Max 2 approved Corruption Bios per org; the leader needs no bio. Corruption already proven and punished ICLY through court gets no OOC punishment.

rules.name: State employees in a gang HQ only for raids
rules.short: State employees in a gang HQ only for raids
rules.text: State employees may only enter a gang HQ for raids. you may not enter during preparation period
rules.exception: EMS responding to calls, and LEO undercover work.

context.hq: Only for raids, never during the preparation period. Exceptions: EMS on calls, LEO undercover work.

rules.name: Clean background
rules.text: All state employees must maintain a clean background.

rules.name: Armoured cars only when the RP allows
rules.short: Armoured cars only when the RP allows
rules.text: Armoured cars may only be used if the Roleplay situation allows it. (i.e. Store Robberies, State of Emergencies, Raids)
rules.note: Allowed examples in the text: store robberies, states of emergency, raids.

rules.name: Org vehicles not for personal use
rules.short: Org vehicles not for personal use
rules.text: Using organization vehicles for personal use is forbidden.

rules.name: Bodycam on duty, kept 72 hours
rules.text: It is mandatory to record and maintain bodycam at all times whilst on duty for 72 hours.

rules.name: Stalling the arrest
rules.text: Stalling or delaying the arrest process is forbidden.

rules.name: Trunk confiscation with RP + script
rules.text: Trunk confiscations must be performed using proper RP commands and the server script. /me uses a crowbar to break the trunk open.

rules.name: Arrest done within 30 minutes of cuffing (lawyer pause)
rules.short: Arrest done within 30 minutes of cuffing
rules.text: The arrest procedure must be completed within 30 minutes after the suspect is handcuffed.
rules.exception: If the suspect requests a lawyer, the timer pauses, and the lawyer has 10 minutes to get to the situation, otherwise the arrest may continue.

rules.name: Danger zone patrol: at least 2 members
rules.short: Danger zone patrol: at least 2 members
rules.text: Patrolling the danger zone requires at least 2 members
rules.exception: LSPD Detectives, FIB Undercover Agents

rules.name: State orgs respond to all situations
rules.short: State orgs respond to all situations
rules.text: All state organizations must respond to all situations. (Exception, IC jurisdiction, SANG, GovT employees, and EMS)
rules.punishment: Verbal warning, up to formal warning.
rules.exception: IC jurisdiction, SANG, GovT employees, and EMS

rules.name: IA must stay clean; orgs need a working IA
rules.short: IA must stay clean; orgs need a working IA
rules.text: all IA members within legal orgs must remain as good cops and may not be corrupt by any means, legal orgs must ensure that they have a working IA department
rules.punishment: warn to the player and Org

rules.name: Org clothing on duty
rules.text: State organisations must wear their organisation clothing while on active duty, unless they have been given an undercover rank that allows them to wear alternative clothing.
rules.exception: unless they have been given an undercover rank that allows them to wear alternative clothing

rules.name: DOJ sits in the Government
rules.text: The government houses the Department of Justice (DOJ), including all judges and attorneys.

rules.name: Appointment of judges
rules.text: District Court Judges are appointed by the Supreme Court Justice. The Supreme Court Justice is appointed by the vote of the senator(s).

rules.name: Courts accept cases within 72 h
rules.text: Courts must accept cases no later than 72 hours after they are filed.

rules.name: Courts act within 72 h of accepting
rules.short: Courts act within 72 h of accepting
rules.text: Courts must take action no later than 72 hours after accepting a case.

rules.name: Judges record hearings, POV kept 72 h
rules.short: Judges record hearings, POV kept 72 h
rules.text: Judges must record all court hearings and keep POV footage for 72 hours, which must be presented upon request by the curator.
rules.punishment: Verbal, up to warn to the org

rules.name: Changing name/appearance to avoid court
rules.text: Changing name or appearance to avoid court is forbidden.

rules.name: Government: 2 IC public events weekly
rules.text: The government must host 2 in-character (IC) public events weekly, subject to prior approval by the curator.

rules.name: Laws must not contradict OOC rules
rules.short: Laws must not contradict OOC rules
rules.text: The government has the right to create laws, legislation, and bills, provided they do not contradict out-of-character (OOC) rules or RP standards. These must be approved by the chief state curator.

rules.name: DOJ maintains and enforces legislation
rules.text: The DOJ is responsible for maintaining and enforcing legislation; appropriate actions must be taken in cases of breaches.

rules.name: AG & SCJ review case files ASAP
rules.short: AG & SCJ review case files ASAP
rules.text: The Attorney General and Supreme Court Justice are responsible for reviewing all case files submitted by state organizations as soon as possible.

rules.name: Max court fines / restitution: 250k
rules.text: the max court ruling of fines or restitution to be paid is 250k and may not exceed that amount.

rules.name: EMS staff in hospitals at all times
rules.short: EMS staff in hospitals at all times
rules.text: EMS must always have employees present in hospitals to heal players and sell medication at all times.

rules.name: EMS respond to all calls
rules.text: EMS must respond to all calls for help.

rules.name: EMS assist every player unless fearing for their lives
rules.short: EMS assist every player unless fearing for their lives
rules.text: EMS employees are obligated to provide assistance to every player unless EMS fears for their lives.
rules.exception: unless EMS fears for their lives

rules.name: Chief Doctor sets internal rules
rules.text: Chief Doctor sets internal rules (must be approved by government/curator).

rules.name: EMS stay out of active gunfights
rules.short: EMS stay out of active gunfights
rules.text: EMS must not assist unconscious players during active gunfights — evacuate the area until safe. No healing or looting in combat.
rules.note: Stacks with the FailRP (GR 6.6) / FearRP (GR 6.8) punishment.

rules.name: No stopping / interfering with EMS on a call
rules.short: No stopping / interfering with EMS on a call
rules.text: No stopping or interfering with EMS employees while they are on a call (exception: special operations or approved scenarios).
rules.exception: special operations or approved scenarios

rules.name: LI editors on duty at all times
rules.short: LI editors on duty at all times
rules.text: LI must have employees editing ads at all times.

rules.name: LI employees are civilians
rules.text: All LI employees are treated as normal civilians and may engage in illegal activities.

rules.name: LI may keep its information private
rules.short: LI may keep its information private
rules.text: LI has the right as a private organization to keep their information private from legal organizations.
rules.exception: Court order for a specific set of information.

rules.name: LI follows legislation in org activity
rules.short: LI follows legislation in org activity
rules.text: LI must abide by legislation while conducting organizational activities.

rules.name: LI: 2 events a week
rules.text: LI must host at least 2 events a week (1 during the week, 1 on weekends).

rules.name: LI: 1 article a week
rules.text: LI must provide at least 1 article a week.

rules.name: LI: game/talent show every 2 weeks
rules.text: LI must host a game show/talent show every 2 weeks.

rules.name: FIB raids need a DOJ/GOV-approved case file
rules.short: FIB raids need a DOJ/GOV-approved case file
rules.text: FIB is responsible for conducting raids on criminal elements in Los Santos and must create a case file to be submitted and approved by the DOJ/GOV.

rules.name: Raids start on time
rules.text: Raids conducted by FIB must start on time; any delay or early start is forbidden.
rules.exception: Another situation arises.

rules.name: SANG may shoot trespassers on sight
rules.short: SANG may shoot trespassers on sight
rules.text: SANG has the right to shoot any trespassers on sight.
rules.note: Not RDM: SANG shooting a trespasser on sight is allowed by this rule.

rules.name: SANG ammo runs for state orgs
rules.short: SANG ammo runs for state orgs
rules.text: SANG must conduct ammo runs for state organizations without exception.

rules.name: Raid needs a serious IC reason, on criminal-org territory
rules.short: Raid needs a serious IC reason, on criminal-org territory
rules.text: It is forbidden to do raid without a serious IC reason(e.g. Case file) Raids are carried out on the territory of a criminal organization or group.

rules.name: Same gang not raided twice in 48 h
rules.short: Same gang not raided twice in 48 h
rules.text: Same gang cannot be raided twice in 48hrs

rules.name: Raid prime time 9:00–15:00
rules.text: Prime time for raids 9:00 to 15:00

rules.name: Who issues the raid warrant
rules.text: Raid warrant is issued by the Attorney Generals Office: Attorney General, Governor or his/her deputies can sign the case file after reviewed by AG office, in the absence of an active government, the raid warrant is issued by the Leader of the FIB department.

rules.name: Vehicles on criminal-faction territory may be searched
rules.short: Vehicles on criminal-faction territory may be searched
rules.text: It is allowed to search vehicles located on the territory of the criminal faction.

rules.name: Terms: 30 days, max 2 consecutive
rules.text: All Leaders terms are 30 days with a max consecutive term limit of 2 Terms (reward will be given after 2 terms and is subject to limited warnings)

rules.name: Leaders follow all rules
rules.text: Leaders are expected to fully comply with all rules strictly put forward in rules for state, event rules and general rules.

rules.name: Active org, no inner OOC conflict
rules.short: Active org, no inner OOC conflict
rules.text: Leaders are expected to keep an active org with no inner OOC conflict which is detrimental to the org.

rules.name: Leaders may be corrupt (caught = arrest + removal)
rules.text: Leaders may be corrupt but must understand acting in a corrupt manor and being caught, will lead to being arrested, and will result in your removal from leadership
rules.note: The rule text sets the outcome: being caught leads to arrest and removal from leadership. For state-org leaders see SR 1.2 (must be proven ICLY through the court system; no extra OOC punishment once punished ICLY).

rules.name: Good, competent RP from the org
rules.short: Good, competent RP from the org
rules.text: Leaders are expected to ensure their orgs are creating good competent roleplay at all times

rules.name: Reward after 2 terms
rules.text: Upon completion of 2 terms successfully a leader may ask for a reward of their choosing (ex: clothing, vehicle, LBC).

rules.name: Leader activity
rules.text: Leaders are expected to be active at all times during their terms, random inactivity spanning multiple days without letting your curator know is forbidden

rules.name: Respect (harassment, bullying, hate speech)
rules.text: All members must treat others with respect. Harassment, bullying, hate speech, or personal attacks will not be tolerated.

rules.name: Toxic behaviour
rules.text: Toxic behaviour, unnecessary arguments, trash talking, or intentionally creating a negative environment within chats is forbidden.

rules.name: Public drama
rules.text: Any issues between members should be taken to staff privately. Creating drama, arguments, or conflicts in public channels is not allowed.

rules.name: Correct channels
rules.text: Members are expected to use the correct channels for conversations and avoid disrupting chats or misusing channels.

rules.name: Spam
rules.text: Spamming messages, emojis, mentions, or intentionally flooding channels is forbidden.

rules.name: Advertising
rules.text: Advertising other Discord servers, services, or communities without staff permission is not allowed.

rules.name: Appropriate profile (name, avatar, status)
rules.text: Members must keep usernames, profile pictures, statuses, and messages appropriate for the community.

rules.name: NSFW / offensive content
rules.text: NSFW, offensive, or inappropriate content is strictly prohibited.

rules.name: Follow staff; no public arguing with moderation
rules.short: Follow staff; no public arguing with moderation
rules.text: Members must follow staff instructions and respect moderation decisions. Publicly arguing with staff actions is not permitted.

rules.name: Bypassing punishments
rules.text: Any attempt to bypass punishments, including bans or mutes, will result in further action being taken.

rules.name: Staff discretion (unlisted behaviour)
rules.text: Staff reserve the right to take action against behaviour that negatively impacts the community, even if it is not specifically listed within these rules.

rules.name: Enlarged weapons (magazines, silencers)
rules.text: Enlarging weapons beyond game standards (magazines, silencers, etc. must not extend too far)

rules.name: Changed rate of fire / weapon characteristics
rules.short: Changed rate of fire / weapon characteristics
rules.text: Changing rate of fire or any other weapon characteristics

rules.name: Cut / removed animations (e.g. fall)
rules.text: Cutting or removing animations (e.g. fall animations)

rules.name: Changed tracers (removing them is allowed, own risk)
rules.text: Changing standard tracers (including color) —  Removing tracers is allowed at your own risk (Ghostpeak)
rules.exception: Removing tracers is allowed at your own risk (Ghostpeak)
rules.note: Removing tracers is allowed, but a player who does it takes the risk of ghost-peek accusations (CR T9).

rules.name: Removed objects / textures (bushes, grass, stones)
rules.text: Removing any objects or textures from the game (bushes, grass, stones, etc.)

rules.name: No waves / see-through water
rules.text: No waves / see-through water

rules.name: Extended player models / changed hitboxes
rules.text: Extending player models or changing hitboxes

rules.name: Luminous / skin-glow effects
rules.text: Using luminous, skin glow, or similar visual effects that provide an unfair advantage by making other players easier to spot or see.

rules.name: Changed vehicle characteristics
rules.text: Changing any characteristics of vehicles (cars, helicopters, etc.)

rules.name: Item & effect modifications
rules.text: Item & Effect Modifications

rules.name: Changed alcohol / drug / item effects
rules.text: Changing alcohol, drug, or any other ingame item effects

rules.name: Shutting down Windows logs and events
rules.short: Shutting down Windows logs and events
rules.text: Shutting down Windows logs and events

rules.name: PC cleaning / prefetch / recent files
rules.text: PC cleaning / cleaning prefetch and recent files (will be punished)
